versions.name: Start Position Viewer
versions.description: View and manage all start positions in the editor from a convenient panel.

about:
# Start Position Viewer

View, edit, enable/disable, and name all of the start positions in your level from a single panel.

No more scrolling through the editor trying to find the start positions you want to edit!

## Features

- **View all start positions** sorted by their position in the level
- **Enable/Disable** individual start positions or all at once
- **Edit settings** change speed, gamemode, mini, dual, and mirror directly
- **Rename** custom names for every start pos
- **Go To** instantly jump to any start position in the editor

## How to Use

In the editor, press the custom button in the playtest menu (next to the **playtest** and **playback** buttons) to open the Start Position Viewer panel.
changelog:
# 1.2.0
- Added `cvolton.level-id-api` as a dependency, fixing the issue where Start Position names were lost in certain conditions.
- Improved performance when toggling Start Positions and clicking "Enable All" / "Disable All" by caching the Start Position objects upon opening the menu, instead of iterating over every single object in the level.
- Removed `typeinfo_cast`s across the codebase to save on resources.
- Using `CCScene::get()` instead of `getRunningScene()`.
- Removed unnecessary hook priority code.

# 1.1.2
- Fixed a crash that happened when a start position was deleted in the editor while its settings menu was still open.
- Rewrote memory management using weak references so the mod doesn't crash on editor exit.
- Replaced manual positioning of the editor button with Geodes layout system. It now sits perfectly next to the playtest and playback buttons and scales with them.
- Cleaned up string IDs and removed unnecessary _spr prefixes.

# 1.1.1
- Added a counter to the panel that displays the total number of start positions in the level.

# 1.1.0
- Replaced mirror portal toggle with flip gravity toggle.
- Refactored codebase into modular files.
- Updated to Geode SDK 5.7.1.
- Fixed memory management for PopupReopener.
- Fixed start position names bleeding across different levels.
- Cleaned up UI code to properly use Geode's node IDs and layout systems.
- Removed unnecessary fallback sprites to strictly adhere to index guidelines.

# 1.0.0
- Initial Release.
